about: 설문 한 바퀴를 화면만으로 — 설문조사입력(제목 · 외부 · 단답형 질문 하나) [저장] '설문조사를 진행하시겠습니까?' → 설문조사 목록 [응답하기] → 답 넣고 [제출] → '참여' → 설문조사현황 [검색(F8)] 출력물에 응답 × 질문 한 줄. 끝에 지운다. node qa/shot.mjs qa/flows/survey-roundtrip.json

shots.name: 설문조사입력 — 화면으로 저장
steps: js:(() => { const tr = document.querySelector('.ec-grid-input tbody tr'); const s = tr.querySelector('select'); Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLSelectElement.prototype, 'value').set.call(s, 'SHORT_TEXT'); s.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); const i = [...tr.querySelectorAll('input')].find((x) => x.type !== 'checkbox' && !x.disabled); Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLInputElement.prototype, 'value').set.call(i, 'QA좋아하는 점심메뉴는?'); i.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); return true })()
js:window.__asked = ''; window.confirm = (m) => { window.__asked = m; return true }; true

shots.name: 설문조사 — 응답하기 → 제출 → 참여
steps: js:(() => { const d = [...document.querySelectorAll('[role=dialog]')].pop(); const i = [...d.querySelectorAll('input')].find((x) => x.type !== 'radio' && x.type !== 'checkbox' && x.type !== 'date'); Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLInputElement.prototype, 'value').set.call(i, 'QA김치찌개'); i.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); [...d.querySelectorAll('button')].find((b) => b.textContent.trim() === '제출').click(); return true })()

shots.name: 정리
steps: js:(async () => { const H = { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + localStorage.getItem('erp_token') }; const d = await (await fetch('/api/surveys', { headers: H })).json(); const out = []; for (const s of (d.rows ?? d).filter((x) => x.title.startsWith('QA그룹웨어'))) out.push((await fetch('/api/surveys/' + s.id, { method: 'DELETE', headers: H })).status); return 'del ' + out.join(',') })()
